note: Classes the developers' markup or scripts need that no PART styles. Add one only when a script or a parent selector needs it, with the reason.

hooks.uxt-insights: Section name on the homepage Insights section. Kept so the section can be targeted; no styles yet.
hooks.uxt-logo-dark: Marks the dark version of a client logo in the logo strip.
hooks.uxt-cta-again: "Send another" button in the booking form; the footer script finds it with this class.
hooks.uxt-wwd-page: Added to <body> by the What we do script while the page is open.
hooks.is-invalid: Added to a booking form field by the footer script when it fails validation.
hooks.is-leaving: Added by the What we do capabilities script during the card animation.
hooks.is-moved: Added by the What we do capabilities script during the card animation.
hooks.is-pinned: Added by the What we do capabilities script when the tab bar is pinned.
hooks.uxt-contact-form-wrap: Contact page form: holds the form and its success message; the contact form script finds the success message inside it.
hooks.uxt-contact-form-again: "Book another" button in the Contact page form; the contact form script finds it with this class.

developerNames.underline-sky-blue: With uxt-subheading: the sky blue line under the eyebrow (light sections).
developerNames.underline-white: With uxt-subheading: the white line under the eyebrow (dark sections).
developerNames.cta-top: Booking card layout (footer global section, PART E and L).
developerNames.cta-bottom: Booking card layout (footer global section, PART E and L).
developerNames.cta-bottom-left: Booking card layout (footer global section, PART E and L).
developerNames.cta-bottom-right: Booking card layout (footer global section, PART E and L).
